source_title: AICPA DC section 200 — 2018 Description Criteria (revised implementation guidance, 2022)

items.text: Identify the services described and their boundaries.
Confirm principal service commitments and system requirements.
Describe infrastructure, software, people, procedures and data, including responsibilities.
Evaluate significant system incidents, their timing, impact and disposition during the period.
Connect applicable criteria with the controls actually designed and implemented.
Identify necessary complementary user entity controls, if applicable; distinguish other customer responsibilities.
Describe relevant subservice organizations, inclusive or carve-out treatment, dependencies and monitoring.
Explain why any otherwise applicable criterion is not relevant; outsourcing alone is not an exclusion.
For Type 2, describe significant system and control changes across the reporting period.
